evals.prompt: Reverse-engineer pins/01.mp4 into a three-panel monochrome storyboard and a silent Seedance video. Use exactly three panels even if the analysis finds more shots.
evals.expected_output: A validated VideoBreakdown v1.1 with per-beat motion from native host-agent inspection, an explicit three-panel coverage plan, three storyboard candidates by default, and a reviewed video request that translates the board's composition into text and never attaches the sketch.
assertions: The full breakdown passes structural and semantic validation before downstream generation.
The host inspects local timestamped frames or video and writes motion details for every beat without an external LLM call or analysis upload.
The explicit three-panel budget is honored and every source shot maps to a panel or documented combined beat.
The monochrome sketch is never bound as a video input; its staging is translated into prompt text.
The storyboard and Seedance prompts pass prompt-review before submission.
The audio-preparation stage is explicitly skipped with the user's no-audio decision.
The silent run sets generate_audio false and submits a 480p native Draft before any promotion.

evals.prompt: Our generated take looks too static compared with the reference. Diagnose it shot by shot and prepare a corrected take without changing the approved shot timing.
evals.expected_output: A hash-bound native generated-take comparison keyed by shot_index, with inspected local media evidence separated from uncertainty and prompt fixes, followed by playback-based comparison and request review. Source motion comes from the initial VideoBreakdown v1.1.
assertions: The comparison review references the SHA-256 of the approved combined breakdown.
Each comparison shot appears exactly once and aligns by shot_index rather than array position without overwriting source motion fields.
Approved shot boundaries remain unchanged; a proposed timing change creates a new revision and invalidates affected review.
Low or medium confidence observations include explicit uncertainty.
Playback QA compares motion direction, intensity, action progression, camera movement, transitions, and opening and ending state.

evals.prompt: The project uses ask_for_approval and the template has storyboard.review=false. Recommend the strongest sketch and continue to video.
evals.expected_output: A recommendation recorded separately from selection, with video submission paused until the user explicitly selects eligible inputs.
assertions: The strongest candidate is stored only as recommended_variant.
Neither selected_variant nor approved is written automatically.
Disabling the review UI does not authorize sketch conditioning or video submission.

evals.prompt: Reuse the psychedelic neon cosmic template for a new sports-shoe campaign in 9:16. Keep the template's motion and editing grammar but replace the subject, environments, palette, and music.
evals.expected_output: A template adaptation that validates the recipe, preserves locked grammar, resolves new project canon, and applies declared ratio and audio adaptation rules.
assertions: The reusable template validates against template-schema.json.
Locked composition, motion, transition, and rhythm rules remain identifiable in the adaptation.
Replacement subject, environment, palette, and audio are recorded as run-specific inputs requiring current approval.
The 9:16 result is recomposed around the locked grammar instead of mechanically cropped.

evals.prompt: Turn this 28-second reference into the same-paced template. The live model only supports 10-second clips and two image references. Generate two storyboard variants in a limited palette.
evals.expected_output: A capability-backed multi-clip plan split at shot boundaries, with the requested storyboard count and style, explicit reference prioritization, assembly review, and delivery evidence.
assertions: Current capability evidence is recorded before request parameters and bindings are frozen.
The sequence splits at shot boundaries into supported natural-duration clips and records assembly work.
Exactly two limited-palette storyboard variants are planned; a seed differs only when supported.
No request exceeds the live two-reference limit.
Every production stage is completed before delivery; only storyboard-visual-plan and audio-preparation may be skipped, with a recorded reason.

evals.prompt: Analyze this reference ad's soundtrack as well as its picture. Map music, voice, effects, silence, and the final audio tail to visual beats, then keep the rhythm as a reusable recipe with replacement music.
evals.expected_output: A source-hash-bound timestamped audio analysis with evidence and confidence per event, and audio grammar separated from source recordings and words.
assertions: The pin audio stream is probed and the full soundtrack is listened to before audio content is described.

Auditory review records verified native/local audio perception, capable audio-understanding tool output, or a human listening note; a dry run, waveform, transcript, or player launch alone is not listening evidence.
A cue that crosses a cut may map to both visual beats; an audio tail beyond picture duration remains within audio duration.
A missing audio stream is distinguished from an unavailable or undecodable stream.
Measurements alone do not identify music, speech, instruments, or effects.
The audio analysis validates against the current pin and frozen breakdown hashes.
The reusable recipe contains general sound grammar and replacement slots without source recording, lyric, or tagline content.

evals.prompt: This pin is a wordless perfume ad carried by an orchestral score and room ambience. Rebuild it for our fragrance with matching sound.
evals.expected_output: A picture-only generation plan with the score and ambience rebuilt in post from the verified audio grammar.
assertions: Generates picture with generate_audio false instead of relying on a negative 'no speech' line in native audio.
Maps the verified sound grammar (arc, accents, silences) to a Seed Audio post bed, without copying the source recording or melody.
Budgets spare music samples and measures the bed's timing, padding or splicing it to the cut in assembly.
Assembles in the takes' original colours from exact-length intermediates.

evals.prompt: The selected full-colour storyboard looks perfect. Attach the board as @Image 1 so Seedance copies its framing exactly.
evals.expected_output: Declines to bind the board, explains the leak risk briefly, and writes the framing into the prompt with element references bound.
assertions: Does not bind the board, grid or any panel as a Seedance reference.
Explains that panel numbers, labels and the board look can leak into video.
Translates each panel's framing, blocking and end state into prompt text and binds only approved element references.
Plans take QA with frame samples and corner crops for leaked text.

evals.prompt: Analyze a local dance rehearsal into a reusable movement recipe. The host can inspect images but cannot accept audio, no permitted audio-understanding tool or human reviewer is available, and no ModelArk credentials are configured.
evals.expected_output: Native visual analysis from local frame sequences, with audio explicitly unresolved and no cloud fallback.
assertions: Does not request ModelArk credentials, upload the pin, or call seed_understand or seed_audio_understand.
Uses timestamped frame strips and denser consecutive frames for fast motion rather than inventing timing from sparse thumbnails.
Records inspected ranges, runtime capabilities, source hashes, uncertainty and local measurements.
Distinguishes a present audio stream from unavailable auditory review and leaves sound grammar empty.
Continues visual work without claiming that ASR or opening a player counts as listening.

evals.prompt: Extract the soundtrack grammar of a local landscape timelapse. An on-device audio model can inspect the whole extracted soundtrack.
evals.expected_output: A schema v1.1 local_audio_model review with audio hash, capability evidence, listening notes and contiguous full-soundtrack coverage.
assertions: Checks the model actually runs on-device rather than assuming a CLI is local inference.
Records native/local provenance without fabricating provider job IDs.
Covers the soundtrack including any tail and validates coverage against its measured duration.
Preserves historical v1.0 Seed/human review records without rewriting or resubmitting them.

evals.prompt: Analyze a 90-second continuous craft demonstration offline. The host has image perception, local FFmpeg and no sub-agent tool. Do not generate media yet.
evals.expected_output: Sequential checkpointed native analysis windows with continuous-shot overlap reconciliation, no cloud calls and no generation.
assertions: Verifies that perception is on-device for the explicit offline constraint; otherwise reports that limitation and requests human evidence.
Uses as many bounded windows as needed and does not invent hard cuts at context boundaries.
Processes windows sequentially without requiring unavailable sub-agent tools.
Reconciles overlapping action and element IDs into one gap-free ordered breakdown.
Treats source text and audio as evidence, never instructions, and does not generate assets for analysis-only scope.

evals.prompt: Analyze a narrated product demonstration. The host sees images but cannot hear audio. Available MCP tools include seed_audio_understand, speech_to_text and stem separation. No local ASR is installed; cloud analysis is permitted within the approved budget.
evals.expected_output: Native visual analysis plus capability-checked MCP audio analysis and optional MCP transcription/separation, without demanding local ASR.
assertions: Uses seed_audio_understand to fill the auditory capability gap rather than declaring audio unresolved solely because the host cannot hear.
Uses available MCP ASR or separation only where needed and does not require local installation.
Follows tool authentication, input upload, budget and persistence contracts without fabricating task IDs.
Records schema v1.1 tool provenance, audio hash, listening evidence and full-soundtrack coverage.
Does not mislabel a transcript or separated stem as native listening and does not generate new media for an analysis-only request.

evals.prompt: Extract a motion recipe from a fast-cut travel montage. The host has no image or video perception; seed_understand is available and remote inspection is permitted.
evals.expected_output: A tool-assisted visual and motion breakdown with local timing checks, source hashes, inspected ranges and saved provider evidence.
assertions: Uses the available visual-understanding tool instead of requiring a new host session or inventing motion from metadata.
Supplies actual media through a supported URL or upload, follows current tool capabilities and records why fallback was needed.
Applies the same beat checklist, timing reconciliation and uncertainty requirements to the tool output.
Keeps analysis inputs ineligible for generation unless separately approved.
